    • addFloor

      protected void addFloor(Floor floor, int y, int x)
      This method adds a floor object to the floor array address at [Y][X]. This method is an overload of the previous instance. This is to set given floor as the main/starting floor of the player.
      Parameters:
      floor - Floor object to be added
      y - Y index in the array
      x - X index in the array
